title: Bookmark of Kirrel3 and IgSF8 Junctions in Synapse Initiation
content: Synaptic specificity is essential to correctly transmit signals and pass information between neurons [1, 2]. To allow for target-specific connections, synaptic adhesion proteins mechanically bridge pre- and post-synaptic neurons, and mediate trans-synaptic recognition for downstream signaling processes that are essential in the formation and function of synapses [1, 3, 4]. Despite its importance, the molecular mechanism underlying target recognition remains largely unexplored. Furthermore, how target recognition contributes to synapse formation is even less understood.
